Goal `tools-php-differences`: all 12 features of the chapter have their proofs. `bun nv proofs --owed --group tools:php-differences` lists none. `bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes tools-php-differences` and `bun nv playbook --closes tools-php-differences` were green this session.
`two-spellings-side-by-side` has one example, two attacks, two `.nvst` cases and one Rust test. The chapter's four blocks ran as written, so no row was corrected.
A proof found a bug and it is fixed: `E0211`'s help said the replacing class was not implemented. It now names the `Core` member, as `rule:statements/no-host-populated-variables` has it, and `every_core_member_a_refused_superglobal_names_is_registered` in `crates/nvs-types/tests/core_members.rs` holds each name against the registry.
A proof found a second bug and it is recorded, not fixed: `nvs-runtime/a-loop-that-only-creates-objects-passes-the-memory-limit`. A loop that only creates objects holds several times `[limits] memory` and exits `0`. This is a priority 1 finding. The attack `02-a-cart-that-grows-past-the-memory-limit.nvs` carries its marker.
Five gaps are open: that one, `nvs-ir/a-require-with-a-computed-path-runs-nothing`, `nvs-types/a-never-method-that-reaches-its-end-returns`, `nvs-syntax/a-second-namespace-statement-in-one-file-compiles` and `nvs-runtime/a-loop-that-only-concatenates-never-stops`. Which goal owns each is not checked.
The two floor checks that were red after the last session, `nvs-cli` test `agent` and `nvs-ir` test `refusals`, pass on this tree. `docs/novis.md`, `docs/reference/lang/95-testing.md` and `docs/reference/tools/10-cli.md` carry somebody else's uncommitted edit and this session did not touch or stage them.

items.text: **`nvs-runtime/a-loop-that-only-creates-objects-passes-the-memory-limit`** — find why the back-edge poll does not report a breach under `nvs run` (`rule:testing/a-failing-proof-is-fixed-or-recorded`). The flag is raised at `crates/nvs-runtime/src/budget.rs:785` only when the thread's ceiling is not `0`, and `crates/nvs-runtime/src/budget.rs:470` returns early on a null polled word; who arms both for a run is not checked. An object is allocated with no budget question at `crates/nvs-runtime/src/object.rs:3856`. The fix removes the marker from `tests/hostile/tools/php-differences/two-spellings-side-by-side/02-a-cart-that-grows-past-the-memory-limit.nvs:6`, and likely closes `a-loop-that-only-concatenates-never-stops` with it.

backlog: `$_GET` refused with `E0211` is followed by `E0301` and `E0401` on the same token, which repeat the refusal; whether a rule allows the cascade is not checked (`docs/rules/statements.md`).
`while ($x != null) { $x = $x->next; }` is `E0459` on a nullable local the loop assigns, and `?->` is the way to write it; whether that is decided is not checked (`docs/rules/types.md`).
The pack did not print `rule:statements/no-host-populated-variables`, which the last feature's `$_GET` block rests on: `[context] rules` was missing it.
